risk_summary: The disclosure is generally detailed and quantitatively supported, reporting substantial profitability, cash generation, margins, commodity movements, and sustainability commitments. Risk factors include labor costs, inflation, currency volatility, geopolitical uncertainty, avian influenza, demand variability, and input-cost exposure, although management presents mitigation efforts with a predominantly confident tone. The excerpt is lengthy and contains some boilerplate and judgment-based accounting language, with the truncated results section limiting assessment of weaker performance areas.
